title: introduce multi-sdk credential probe and async-to-generator adapter for streaming ergonomics
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a lightweight, language-agnostic credential probe endpoint and a Python async-to-generator adapter to improve SDK ergonomics and parity across Py/TS/Go. Motivation: many downstream apps still rely on sync generators or simple for-await loops; Python's asyncio generators and TypeScript async-iterables had subtle ergonomic gaps leading to token refresh races and duplicated reauth logic. This PR centralizes a small probe API used by SDKs to validate credential freshness without performing a full request, and introduces an adapter layer so Python consumers can opt-in to generator-style streaming without rewriting asyncio code. Changes include SDK surface updates, telemetry for probe usage, example app updates, and version bumps for each SDK. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-2148) [x] add probe endpoint to control plane client [x] implement probe client in SDKs [x] implement Python adapter with tests [x] TS generator-friendly wrapper and minor Go ergonomics helpers [x] update docs and quickstarts [x] bump SDK versions and changelogs.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) api: add credential probe handler and proto + control-plane wiring 2) sdk: multi-sdk probe client, telemetry and errors mapping 3) py/ts/go: adapters/tests/docs/version bumps

Bumped SDK versions: python -> 0.14.0, typescript -> 1.7.0, go -> 1.6.0. See docs/sdk/credential-probe.md for migration notes.
